enable_style_aligned: enable StyleAligned shared attention and normalization for style-consistent batch image generation
disable_style_aligned: disable StyleAligned shared attention and normalization to restore default UNet processors
run_style_aligned_generation: run text-to-image generation with StyleAligned to share style across multiple prompts in a batch
create_shared_attention_processor: create a SharedAttentionProcessor that applies AdaIn normalization and shared attention across batch images
configure_style_aligned_params: configure StyleAligned parameters including adain_queries, adain_keys, share_attention, and only_self_level
